mapper.select:
SELECT p.project_id AS projectId, p.client_id AS clientId, p.title AS title, p.description AS description, p.start_date AS startDate, p.deadline_date AS deadlineDate, p.est_duration AS estDuration, p.budget AS budget, p.communicate_method AS communicateMethod, p.payment_method AS paymentMethod, p.project_status AS projectStatus, p.is_public AS isPublic, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.view_count AS viewCount, p.applicant_count AS applicantCount, p.budget_negotiable AS budgetNegotiable, p.duration_negotiable AS durationNegotiable, p.plan_url AS planUrl,
(SELECT stack_level FROM project_stacks WHERE project_id = p.project_id LIMIT 1) AS minLevel,
(SELECT stack_year FROM project_stacks WHERE project_id = p.project_id LIMIT 1) AS minYear, p.max_revision_count AS maxRevisionCount, p.change_policy AS changePolicy,
u.name AS clientName, c.company_name AS companyName, cp.client_type AS clientType, c.industry AS companyIndustry
FROM projects p JOIN users u ON u.user_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN client_profiles cp ON cp.client_id = p.client_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.company_id = cp.company_id WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_applications ( project_id, freelancer_id, application_status, applied_at ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{userId}, 'PENDING', NOW() )
